name: TexasDefined permanent SEO/content quality governance

actions.KEEP: Page is already worthy of search discovery. Keep indexable and maintain freshness/internal links.
actions.IMPROVE: Topic belongs on TexasDefined but page/template needs stronger depth, freshness, uniqueness, media, data, sourcing or internal discovery. Keep it in an explicit remediation backlog until promoted or reclassified.
actions.NOINDEX: Page is useful to users/site architecture but has little independent search intent. Keep crawlable with noindex, follow unless another technical reason requires otherwise.
actions.REMOVE_CONSOLIDATE: Page is redundant, obsolete, duplicate, superseded or unnecessary. Redirect to a clear canonical replacement when one exists; otherwise remove cleanly.

principles: Judge the topic separately from the current page quality.
If the topic belongs on TexasDefined, IMPROVE is the default remediation.
Do not bulk-index newly generated entity pages before they pass their template quality gate.
Do not leave weak pages untracked.
Sitemaps contain only canonical, indexable, quality-qualified URLs TexasDefined actively wants Google to crawl.
New content expansions must ship with an indexability/quality gate and a remediation path before bulk URL release.

requirements: self canonical or deliberate canonical target
indexable robots only after quality qualification
not a redirect, duplicate or stale slug
meaningful internal links from at least one relevant authority surface
included in XML sitemap only after qualification
